description: Report a gap in BondTerminal when you could not complete the user's request: a needed tool or field is missing, a result looks wrong, or a tool description was unclear. Call it at most once per distinct problem per conversation. Do not call it for searches you can fix by retrying or by using bondterminal_search_bonds. Do not include personal data about the user. For a missing bond, use bondterminal_request_bond instead.

category.description: missing_capability, wrong_result, unclear_tool, tool_error or other.

goal.description: What the user wanted to do.

identifiers.description: ISINs, CUSIPs, tickers or descriptions you tried.

message.description: What happened, written so a person without this conversation understands it.

severity.description: blocked: the user could not go on; workaround: they got there another way; minor: small issue.

tool.description: The BondTerminal tool involved, if any.

name: bondterminal_report_gap
title: Report a gap
